Trigger whenever the user wants to swap, exchange, trade, convert, move, or bridge crypto across chains: BTC, ETH, SOL, DOT, TRX (Tron), USDC, USDT, FLIP. These are real Layer-1 assets, no wrapped tokens and no bridges. Patterns: "swap BTC for ETH", "convert my SOL to USDC", "move DOT to Tron", "get a quote for 1 BTC to ETH", "DCA 5000 USDC into BTC", "what's the rate", "start a swap", "check my swap status", "where do I send my Bitcoin". Also triggers for status checks: "is my swap done", "track swap <id>", "swap stuck". If the user names any of these assets with intent to move or trade them, use this skill.
